conversation_summary: The shopper is interested in a T-shirt made from 70% certified organic cotton and 30% TENCEL™ Lyocell, which is lightweight, breathable, and soft-touch. They are 170 centimeters tall and prefer a wide fit, considering their usual size or possibly sizing up for a looser feel. The selected color is white, seen as versatile and stylish. The shopper confirmed their intent to purchase and enjoyed the conversation. Nova confirmed the T-shirt's certifications, including GOTS for organic cotton and OEKO-TEX® Standard 100 for safety and sustainability. The T-shirt features low-water dyeing and a closed-loop fiber process for sustainability, produced in a fair-wage factory for ethical manufacturing. The shopper did not raise any objections and asked for care instructions, which Nova provided, recommending washing in cold water inside-out and line drying to maintain softness and color vibrancy. The conversation ended positively, with the shopper expressing gratitude and satisfaction, indicating they may have further questions or need assistance in the future.
